key_fiscal_facts.value_text: 88-95% total government take at benchmark prices (NIOC retains all production value; IOC earns thin service margin of $3-6/bbl equivalent)
N/A -- Buyback: IOC costs repaid by NIOC from production over contract life; not a % cap but a total amount ceiling
20% flat CIT on remuneration income (Iran Corporate Tax; petroleum sector may pay standard rate on net remuneration)
N/A -- Iran IPC/EPDP: IOC earns fixed remuneration fee (typically $3-6/bbl) plus cost recovery of initial investment; no profit oil mechanism; NIOC retains all production upside
N/A -- Iran uses EPDP/IPC buyback model; government royalty is implicit via NIOC ownership of all production; no separate royalty levy on IOC
NIOC (National Iranian Oil Company) retains 100% ownership of all petroleum assets and production; IOC earns only service remuneration
